steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We won! It's been a long time since I had such a great fight!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, how come you didn't get hurt at all? What a shame. How did I protect you so well?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You look like you wanna give me a good beating.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Haha! Look at your wimpy face! Are you that scared of me?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hmm... A fake smile. You still keep your guard up around me.
After all, she strangled you when you first met. Of course, you keep your guard up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Look at you being so nervous. Tsk. You look so insecure as the Chief. How pathetic.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm starting to like you now, hehe.
That's not what she meant with that derisive look on her face. You ignore her and turn to the gangsters who got battered on the ground.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: *** the Sinners!!! ******!!! Monsters—Go to hell! Go—Mmmmm—Mmmm—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We need to be CIVILIZED and POLITE with our words to maintain the image of our Syndicate.
She shoves her steel pipe into the gangster's mouth and shuts his foul mouth.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are the gangs coming for us?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft, the gangsters will fight anyone. You're just unlucky. Don't be so obsessed with yourself.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is a place of the <color=#fb9259>law of the jungle</color>. Every summer, the gangs fight themselves to death to be the "Syndicate Boss."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content:
Hundreds of passersby get dragged into these idiots' fights every year and die for nothing.
Be careful, Mr. Chief. Don't get yourself killed in your first mission!
steps.female_content:
Hundreds of passersby get dragged into these idiots' fights and die for nothing.
Be careful, Ma'am. Don't get yourself killed in your first mission!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's your job to protect the Chief. I'll deal with you if you fail to do so.
Hecate is still as cold and stiff as always.
She may "follow your orders", but as someone whom you have no idea what's on her mind, she may be further away from you than you think.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Okay, okay, okay! I'm showing you the way now, alright? Get your monster away, you gloomy guy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Strange. They should have had the final showdown a month ago. How come they are still so rowdy...?
The thugs on the ground have been beaten into silence, but they're still writhing around struggling and becoming more and more exhilarated that they even left bite marks on the steel pipes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is not the ordinary power.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief! Stand back!
More thugs are stumbling toward you from street corners with bloodshot eyes and distorted faces, seemingly unable to control their bodies.
A distinctive figure appears in the mob.
It was a young, thin girl with gray hair. She stares at you with hollow eyes, while a dark mist emanates from her body—the shackles in your hands suddenly begin to shake.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe. Now I remember that a group in Syndicate will be very interested in you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...<color=#fb9259>Sinners</color>.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your shackles are an absolute restraint to Sinners, which means <color=#fb9259>you are their worst enemy</color>.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They will try to kill you any way they can.
The gray-haired girl raises her hand, then the dark mist from her body spreads outward. Wherever the mist reaches, the thugs howl and furiously charge past her toward you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's <color=#fb9259>Mania</color>!
